basis: On November 4, Cirrus Logic forecast consolidated revenue of $480 million to $540 million for Q3 FY25, the quarter ended December 28, 2024. The $540 million upper bound was 12.76% below prior-year quarterly net sales of $618,984,000. The entire range therefore fell below the $588,034,800 cutoff.

coverage.detail: August 6, 2024, preceding earnings cycle. The Q1 FY25 shareholder letter explicitly assigned its $490 million to $550 million revenue outlook to the September quarter, Q2 FY25. It gave no December-quarter revenue range.
August 14, Oppenheimer conference. CEO John Forsyth discussed how Cirrus prepared its quarterly guidance. The public remarks supplied no numeric December-quarter revenue bound.

November 4, Q2 FY25 shareholder letter. Management explicitly identified December as the forecast quarter, repeated the $480 million to $540 million range, and put the year-over-year decline at 18% at the midpoint. The forecast reflected one fewer week than the prior-year quarter.

December 12, Barclays conference. Asked whether management’s view of December and March had changed since earnings, interim CFO Ulf Habermann said it was unchanged at that point and discussed the prior-year extra week. He supplied no revised revenue range.

February 4, 2025, actual results. The consolidated statement of operations reported net sales of $555,738,000 for Q3 FY25 and $618,984,000 for Q3 FY24, a 10.22% decline. Actual sales exceeded the November guidance ceiling and still fell below the cutoff.

publication_date_evidence: Cirrus Logic’s November 4, 2024 press release said it had posted the shareholder letter and outlook on its investor website that day. EDGAR independently records acceptance of the 8-K containing both documents on November 4 at 16:02:54. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/772406/000077240624000066/0000772406-24-000066-index.htm
